definition: The Deep Learning Indaba is an annual conference and educational event that aims to strengthen machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI) capacity across Africa.
details: Launched in 2017, it brings together students, researchers, industry practitioners, and policymakers from across the African continent.

explainer.lead: The Deep Learning Indaba is an annual African conference and educational event for machine learning and artificial intelligence. It matters because it connects learning, research, industry, and policy around the shared goal of strengthening AI capacity across the continent.

tiers.eli5: Think of it as a yearly gathering where people across Africa come to learn about smart computer systems and meet others working on them. Students, researchers, company workers, and government decision-makers can share ideas and build connections.
tiers.practitioner: For an engineer, the Indaba is a setting for technical learning and professional exchange rather than a software tool or model. Its practical value lies in connecting practitioners with students, researchers, and policymakers around African machine-learning and AI capacity.
tiers.paperLevel: The Deep Learning Indaba is an annual conference and educational event, launched in 2017, whose objective is to strengthen machine-learning and AI capacity across Africa. Its scope spans students, researchers, industry practitioners, and policymakers rather than a single technical method.

explainer.example: A graduate student attends an Indaba, learns alongside researchers and industry practitioners, and makes connections with others interested in machine learning. That participation supports the event’s broader goal of building African AI capacity.

explainer.outcome: The event creates a recurring meeting point for education and exchange across Africa’s machine-learning and AI community. Its stated aim is stronger AI capacity throughout the continent.
explainer.whyItMatters: It gives African students, researchers, practitioners, and policymakers a common venue focused on machine-learning education and AI capacity. The cross-continental gathering helps connect groups that each contribute to that goal.
